Meet Sous — my Grok Bot kitchen co-pilot.

It picks weeknight dinners and meal plans (who’s eating, allergies incl. baby-/dog-safe, pantry vs recipe mode, Easy mode + auto oven timers), keeps Kitchen Stock + a Cookbook Archive, and can run a potluck signup. Humor on by default;… https://t.co/T2oEJTCLrw
